name: Recruiter
body:
You know how to inspire people to join you.

Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus on any Diplomacy attempts when asking an NPC to give aid. When you recruit hirelings or messengers to work for you personally, you pay only half the listed cost. When you take a Recruit or Lead town action, add +4 to your Diplomacy check.
